cases.name: t3's own tools through the relay (SPI-1039): t3_thread_list
cases.text:
l `t3_thread_list`. None of the tools available to me in this session is a t3-code MCP tool. The only tools I have are file read, bash, edit, and write, and you asked me not to use bash.

To get the thread count, you could run the tool from your t3-code client directly. Or, if the t3-code MCP server is configured for this harness, it may need to be connected or enabled, and then I could try again.
